g.text: one file under .memforge/ decides the mode
a commit signed by a signer already
on the list. The list is read from the first parent, so a
commit that edits the list is judged by the old list and
cannot authorize itself. A mode change deletes the old file
and adds the new one in one commit, judged under the old mode.
A commit whose own tree lacks exactly one valid list is
refused (list_removed). Removing a key stops later commits
only. MemForge has no rotation, revocation or recovery.
a listed key is trusted completely
any listed signer can add another signer
the principal is only a label
a valid list of keys nobody holds blocks syncs
dist, SBOM, PDF; no stored key
